entities.name: Charcadet
entities.short_description: Charcadet is a small humanoid Pokémon. It has a bulky, black, charcoal helmet-like formation on its forehead that comprises most of its face, with burning red notches and a dark red lining at the back of the "helmet".…
entities.description:
Charcadet is a small humanoid Pokémon. It has a bulky, black, charcoal helmet-like formation on its forehead that comprises most of its face, with burning red notches and a dark red lining at the back of the "helmet". Three teardrop-shaped markings form a slight triangular shape on the front of the helmet, and the lower part of its face is back with no visible mouth. It has bright red flaming eyes with yellow irises and white scleras. A plume of red fire with a tint of purple and blue at the tip billows out from the back of its round head. The back of its head is red and orange. Its torso resembles a knight's armor, red in colour with fiery tips, and a slightly protruding orange formation in its center. Its black arms and legs are thick and its red paws and feet are stubby with only one thumb-like digit on each paw. The lower half of its body is black. An orange flame billows out continuously from the center of its back.

Shiny Charcadet look nearly identical to the normal version, with the only difference being the bright blue and cyan colour of its eyes.

It is said that a burnt piece of charcoal leapt from the fire, came to life and took on the form of Charcadet. It possesses a fiery, knight-like spirit and is a very skilled young warrior Pokémon. Charcadet is able to take on stronger opponents much larger than itself. It prefers to eat berries that are rich in fats.

During fights, Charcadet can increase its firepower to temperatures over 1,000 degrees Celsius (1,800 degrees Fahrenheit).

entities.name: Dondozo
entities.short_description: Dondozo is a large, blue catfish-like Pokémon with white fins, whiskers, and underbelly. It has six frills on its head that resemble the headbands worn by sushi chefs, and its tongue resembles a sushi geta when fully…
entities.description:
Dondozo is a large, blue catfish-like Pokémon with white fins, whiskers, and underbelly. It has six frills on its head that resemble the headbands worn by sushi chefs, and its tongue resembles a sushi geta when fully extended.

Shiny Dondozo is yellow instead of blue.

Dondozo rely on Tatsugiri to obtain food, as they are not very smart or fast. They are very gluttonous due to their large size, requiring tons of food on a daily basis. The two Pokémon get along very well, as Tatsugiri allows Dondozo to find ample food, while Dondozo protects Tatsugiri from natural predators.

Dondozo can put Tatsugiri in its mouth to protect it from natural enemies, which in turn causes Dondozo to become significantly stronger and harder to defeat with Tatsugiri's planning. Dondozo are also the only Pokémon to use the unique move Order Up.

entities.name: Capsakid
entities.short_description: Capsakid is a small, green plant like Pokemon that resembles the kappa of Japanese folklore. It lacks arms and has a short stubby tail. Its head has a wide, round cap that splits into 6 radially, and has a small green…
entities.description:
Capsakid is a small, green plant like Pokemon that resembles the kappa of Japanese folklore. It lacks arms and has a short stubby tail. Its head has a wide, round cap that splits into 6 radially, and has a small green section on top. Its orange beak-like mouth has a single buck tooth. It has 2 black beady eyes.

Capsakid is commonly favored among local chefs since the shed tooth this Pokémon leaves behind gives off an extremely spicy aroma and is used as an ingredient in most Paldean dishes.

The amount of spiciness that Capsakid produces is determined by how long it sunbathes; the more sunlight Capsakid absorbs, the more spicy chemicals are produced as well as the moves it uses in battle.

Capaskid evolves into Scovillain if it touches a Fire Stone.

entities.name: Garganacl
entities.short_description: Garganacl is a blocky, golem-like Pokemon which resembles a ziggurat or Mayan pyramid, made of rock salt and sedimentary rock. Its head looks rugged and its face consist of 2 eyes shaped like the outlines of a right…
entities.description:
Garganacl is a blocky, golem-like Pokemon which resembles a ziggurat or Mayan pyramid, made of rock salt and sedimentary rock. Its head looks rugged and its face consist of 2 eyes shaped like the outlines of a right angle that can glow orange red when its active or enraged. It has 3 fingers on its long arms, and both its arms and legs are much larger compared to its torso. It is covered in white squares, presumably being salt.

Garganacl will scrape its long fingers together to create special healing salt.

The salt Garganacl produces is rich in minerals and has a very potent healing ability. Many pokemon gather around it to lick up this special salt.

Garganacl evolves from Naclstack starting at level 38 and is the final evolution of Nacli.

entities.name: Lokix
entities.short_description: Lokix is an anthropomorphic grasshopper-like Pokémon. It has three pairs of legs; the "hands", its normal legs and a third set at the back which it uses in its Showdown mode. It has yellow eyes with a mostly dark torso…
entities.description:
Lokix is an anthropomorphic grasshopper-like Pokémon. It has three pairs of legs; the "hands", its normal legs and a third set at the back which it uses in its Showdown mode. It has yellow eyes with a mostly dark torso with shades of gray. Parts of its hands and legs are also yellow.

Shiny Lokix have parts of their lower bodies, arms and legs a darker shade of gray over normal. The black colors are replaced with a more green-gold appearance.

When going all out, Lokix use their third set of legs to enter Showdown Mode to beat its enemies in short order. However, it places a huge burden on them so they can't stay in Showdown mode for too long.

Lokix evolves from Nymble starting at level 24.

entities.name: Maushold
entities.short_description: Maushold has the same design with its pre-evolution, except one or two smaller members join in.
entities.description:
Maushold has the same design with its pre-evolution, except one or two smaller members join in.

Like their pre-evolution, Maushold create nests with whatever gets their interest. They create huge rooms and act much like a family would, with rooms being used for eating or sleeping. The smaller members appeared before the original pair one day. The exact relationship between them is not known, but the larger members protect the smaller ones in battles. If they face a particularly strong opponent, they will all fight together to defeat them.

Like their pre-evolution, Maushold can use the move Population Bomb. They are also the only Pokémon who can use the move Tidy Up.

Maushold evolves from Tandemaus starting at level 25. Unlike other Pokémon, there is no evolution screen unless they are out of their Poké Ball.

entities.name: Oinkologne
entities.short_description: Oinkologne's form are different depending on the gender, though both are fat, quadrupedal pig-like Pokémon. Male Oinkolonge have a black upper body and light black lower body (also applying on the ears), a larger left…
entities.description:
Oinkologne's form are different depending on the gender, though both are fat, quadrupedal pig-like Pokémon. Male Oinkolonge have a black upper body and light black lower body (also applying on the ears), a larger left ear, pink eyelids, feet, nose, a bulb-like tail tip and thin yellow lower eyelids. Female Oinkolonge have a light brown upper body and dark brown lower body, a larger right ear, brown eyelids, feet, nose, a broom-like tail tip and thick yellow lower eyelids.

Shiny Oinkologne, regardless of the gender, have a light white upper body and pink lower body, almost resembling real-life pigs.

Regardless of their gender, Oinkologne are meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep everything tidy. Male Oinkologne are proud of their fine, glossy skin, while female Oinkologne can entrance other female Pokémon with its sweet, alluring scent.

An Oinkologne emits a floral aroma from its body, which can soothe Pokémon around it, which can even override opposing Pokémon's abilities. This scent can also cause other Pokémon to fall in love with it.

entities.name: Espathra
entities.short_description: Espathra has a very similar appearance to an ostrich, having two very thin legs and a very large plumage. Their eyes are blue and white.
entities.description:
Espathra has a very similar appearance to an ostrich, having two very thin legs and a very large plumage. Their eyes are blue and white.

Despite their appearance, Espathra are known to have quite a temperament.

Espathra uses their large eyes to immobilize enemies with its psychic powers. It can also emit said power from the gaps between its frills and can run at speeds of up to 120 miles per hour. They are also the only Pokémon to use the move Lumina Crash.

Espratha evolves from Flittle starting at level 35.

entities.name: Flittle
entities.short_description: Flittle is small and resembles a chick. It is mostly yellow with with purple on its beak and small legs. It has a purple triangular mark on its forehead. It's body is frilly with two white frills on its head and two…
entities.description:
Flittle is small and resembles a chick. It is mostly yellow with with purple on its beak and small legs. It has a purple triangular mark on its forehead. It's body is frilly with two white frills on its head and two layers of frill wrapped around its waist. The second frill is pink in color. It also has green eyes with eyelashes.

Its frills allow it to levitate due to emitting psychic power, but only limited to half an inch off the ground.

Despite its appearance, it is known to be vengeful, especially to thieves that steal its berries.

Flittle evolves into Espathra starting at level 35.

entities.name: Pawmot
entities.short_description: Pawmot is a rodent Pokémon that appears to be based on a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marmot Marmot ground squirrel]. Their bodies are a deep orange that is covered in scruffy fur. Like all electric-rodent Pokémon,…
entities.description:
Pawmot is a rodent Pokémon that appears to be based on a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marmot Marmot ground squirrel]. Their bodies are a deep orange that is covered in scruffy fur. Like all electric-rodent Pokémon, they have yellow sacs on their cheeks that store electricity. It has large arms and small feet connected to legs that are mostly covered by thick layers of skin and fat. It also has yellow pads on its hands which are used when it releases electricity. It is a dual /-type Pokémon Despite the violent nature of the fighting type, this Pokémon is always smiling.

Although Pawmot's reaction speed is normally low, it is able to strike opponents with fast movements when battling. The fluffy fur on its body acts like a battery, allowing Pawmot to store as much electricity as in an electric car.

Pawmot is the only known Pokémon capable of learning the move Double Shock.

Pawmot evolves from Pawmo if leveled up while outside of its Poké Ball after walking 1000 steps using the Let's Go feature and if the final evolution of Pawmi.

entities.name: Pawmo
entities.short_description: Pawmo is a small rodent whose fur color is light orange. It has the standard Electric-Rodent Electricity Sacs on its cheeks as well as additional ones on its forepaws, it has large arms and five fingers. The fur at the…
entities.description:
Pawmo is a small rodent whose fur color is light orange. It has the standard Electric-Rodent Electricity Sacs on its cheeks as well as additional ones on its forepaws, it has large arms and five fingers. The fur at the end of its arms and on its hands is a light cream color.

Pawmo evolves from Pawmi starting at level 18 and evolves into Pawmot if leveled up while outside of its Poké Ball after walking 1000 steps using the Let's Go! feature.

Like its evolution and pre-evolution, Pawmo is based on a , such as the , which was thought to have dissapeared following the end of the Pleistocene epoch in the before it was successfully reintroduced to the mountainous range in 1948. Its ability of discharging electricity from its paws may be inspired by defibrillators, with its Fighting-type and learning Arm Thrust upon evolving is likely a grim reference to the potential injuries caused by CPR.

The requirement to evolve Pawmo into Pawmot with the Let's Go! feature is a likely reference to Ash's Pikachu, who is always outside of his Poké Ball throughout the entire anime.

entities.name: Kilowattrel
entities.short_description: Kilowattrel, despite being adept at flying, cannot swim well due to the lack of water-proof oil covering its wings. It is able to cover over 430 miles in a single day just by riding the wind.
entities.description:
Kilowattrel, despite being adept at flying, cannot swim well due to the lack of water-proof oil covering its wings. It is able to cover over 430 miles in a single day just by riding the wind.

Kilowattrel evolves from Wattrel starting at level 27.

Kilowattrel is based on a , its ability to inflate its throat sac and cannot dive into water to reflects real life frigatebirds inflates their throat sac during courtship and real life frigatebirds cannot dive due to lacking waterproof feathers.

Kilowattrel may be a combination of 'kilowatt', and 'petrel', which is a species of .

entities.name: Nacli
entities.short_description: Nacli is a small, limbless, square, rock-like pokemon. It has a rough brown stone on its head with a white, cubic salt stone on the top of its head toward the back. It's eyes are rectangular holes with an orange light…
entities.description:
Nacli is a small, limbless, square, rock-like pokemon. It has a rough brown stone on its head with a white, cubic salt stone on the top of its head toward the back. It's eyes are rectangular holes with an orange light behind them. The eyes cannot change their shape, but their color can change depending on their emotion. If Nacli is delighted, it will have yellow eyes, but if it is furious, it will have red eyes. It does not have a visible mouth.

Nacli are born underground where it secretes salt that regenerates over time. This pokemon was treasured by all who studied culinary arts, with this pokemon's salt being used even in ice cream due to its gentle taste.

Nacli and its evolutions are the only known Pokémon that can have Purifying Salt as an Ability.

Nacli evolves into Naclstack starting at level 24 and then evolves into Garganacl starting at level 38.

entities.name: Naclstack
entities.short_description: Naclstack is a symetrical Pokémon made up of cubic stones stacked on top of each other. It possesses corner like orange eyes that have yellow on the tips, and has square legs that possess tiny stones at the bottom that…
entities.description:
Naclstack is a symetrical Pokémon made up of cubic stones stacked on top of each other. It possesses corner like orange eyes that have yellow on the tips, and has square legs that possess tiny stones at the bottom that serve as feet. The tiny stones have a zigzag pattern on them. The back of its body contains a huge brown stone with white diamonds on it. It appears to be made up completely of rock salt.

Naclstack can condense salt down into little pellets and shoot them out at a velocity that can pierce even metal sheets. This Pokémon leaves behind salt everywhere it goes, and people tend to pick up this salt to add to their sandwiches.

Naclstack evolves from Nacli starting at level 24 and evolves into Garganacl starting at level 38.

Naclstack appears to be based on a embedded in a rock.

entities.name: Quaxwell
entities.short_description: Quaxwell is a humanoid looking duck Pokémon, its hair now looks more darker and has a light blue W above its eyes, resembling the pattern on Quaxly's hair. its lower body is more plump and its legs are longer, its…
entities.description:
Quaxwell is a humanoid looking duck Pokémon, its hair now looks more darker and has a light blue W above its eyes, resembling the pattern on Quaxly's hair. its lower body is more plump and its legs are longer, its flippers have blue crescents on the top of them.

This Pokémon is even more sterner than its pre-evolution, always hard on themselves and will overwork unless someone stops them. Quaxwell spend almost all of their free time practicing, particularly focusing on fundamentals.

Whenever they come across other dancers or fellow Quaxwell from other regions, who are also practicing their techniques, they focus intently on their movements, then spend hours repeating them and incorporating the new moves into their own dances. In fact, Quaxwell are fast learners when it comes to picking up on such moves as well, and the techniques can quickly spread across population.

Quaxwell evolves from Quaxly starting at level 16 and evolves into Quaquaval starting at level 36.

entities.name: Mabosstiff
entities.short_description: Mabosstiff is a large dog Pokémon. It has thick, gray eyebrows, black eyes with an orange sclera and nose. Most of its fur is brown, but it also has black and gray fur.
entities.description:
Mabosstiff is a large dog Pokémon. It has thick, gray eyebrows, black eyes with an orange sclera and nose. Most of its fur is brown, but it also has black and gray fur.

Mabosstiff loves playing with children and is very gentle and kind with its friends and family. However, if they become threatened, it snarls at it's enemies to intimidate them from attacking. If this fails, it unleashes the energy stored in its dewlap to blow them away.

Mabosstiff is the only pokemon with the unique ability Guard Dog.

Mabosstiff evolves from Maschiff starting at level 30.

entities.name: Maschiff
entities.short_description: Maschiff is a small doglike Pokemon. It has a streak of yellow hear running from the top of it's head, to the back of it, forming a tail.
entities.description:
Maschiff is a small doglike Pokemon. It has a streak of yellow hear running from the top of it's head, to the back of it, forming a tail.

Maschiff evolves into Mabosstiff starting at level 30.

Maschiff is believed to be inspired by a mastiff puppy, more specifically the Spanish Mastiff, with the shape of its yellow fur resembling a mohawk hairstyle, which is commonly associated with punk culture. The way the face it makes, as well as its Intimidate ability calls back the trope of young Yakuza members with blond hair frequently used in Japanese media, who similarly intimidates people if they bump into one of them.

Maschiff may be based off the words “mischief” and “Mastiff”, a dog breed.

entities.name: Spidops
entities.short_description: Spidops evolves from Tarountula starting at level 15.
entities.description:
Spidops evolves from Tarountula starting at level 15.

Spidops may have been inspired by the Ogre-faced spider or related members of the Deinopidae family (also known as net-casting spiders), who are known to hold their legs together in pairs and cast nets. Its segmented wooden-like body and association with strings may derive cues from marionettes. Its behaviour calls in mind special operation forces, especially its pop culture depiction of secret agents, with its eyes resembling night-vision goggles and chest plating resembling a bulletproof vest, a typical outift for special ops forces. The ability to hang upside-down using its thread evokes the trope of secret agents using cables to hang from ceilings, popularized by the Mission Impossible series of movies, although some real-life spiders showcases this behaviour as well.

Alternatively, it could be based on the yokai Tsuchigumo, who were said to have the face of an oni and the body of a spider. They are known to disguise themselves and capture travelers with its strings, most famously portrayed in the stories, The Tale of the Heike and Tsuchigumo Sōshi.

Spidops may be a combination of spider, spy, ops (abbreviation of "operations"), and Deinopis (genus of the ogre-faced spider).
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Nintendo / Creatures / Game Freak (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Tarountula
entities.short_description: Tarountula is a greenish-yellow arachnid whose bulb is coated in webbing It has eight legs that are split into sets of four, with each leg bearing a green color on the bottom half. It has six eyes, but only the front…
entities.description:
Tarountula is a greenish-yellow arachnid whose bulb is coated in webbing It has eight legs that are split into sets of four, with each leg bearing a green color on the bottom half. It has six eyes, but only the front two possess irises. The irises seems tired or sad most times. Its mouth appears to be made up of four tiny flaps that cover it's gob. Tarountula's natural habitat is in large, shady trees, and their natural enemy is the Scyther. The tensile strength of its webbing is high and is very stretchy like elastic.

Tarountala evolves into Spidops starting at level 15.

Tarountula appears to be based on the and some members of the Uloboridae family, which are non-venomous and wrap their prey in bundles of silk. The silk that wraps up its abdomen into a large ball resembles a yarn ball, though it may be inspired by the spherical pods that create to shelter their eggs. Its shiny coloration resembles the Destiny Knot item.

Its Japanese name, Tamantula, may be a combination of tama (sphere, ball) and tarantula.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Nintendo / Creatures / Game Freak (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Squawkabilly
entities.short_description: Squakabilly appears to be based after a parrot. It sports a black tuft on its head resembling a pompadour and a round yellow beak. Its yellow feet have two toes in the front and two toes in the back as well as orange…
entities.description:
Squakabilly appears to be based after a parrot. It sports a black tuft on its head resembling a pompadour and a round yellow beak. Its yellow feet have two toes in the front and two toes in the back as well as orange claws. Its eyes are half-closed, has white eyelids, and has small black pupils. It naturally comes in four different colors of plumage: green, blue, yellow, and white. The ends of its wings are white.

Shiny Squawkabilly has a light pink tuft instead of a black one, its feet are light pink instead of yellow, and its claws are pink instead of orange.

Similarly to Oricorio, Squawkabilly comes in four different plumages that appear to affect their behavior, although they are known to fight other members of its species with different colored plumages.

They're a noisy bunch, and come in four different colors. They are heavily territorial and have been known to fight for territory against Fletchling, and even other members of their own species of different colors. The Green Squawkabilly are the most numerous, with the blue being second only to green. The yellow are next to last place in number, though they are known to be fierce in battle, which leads to them maintaining their territory well. The White Squawkabilly are of the least amount and hold the least amount of territory. However, the territory they do have they maintain well due to their white color which naturally camouflages them among the buildings.

entities.name: Tandemaus
entities.short_description: Tandemaus consists of two small white mouse Pokémon. They have a pattern on their fur resembling a blue shirt and pants, although very faint.
entities.description:
Tandemaus consists of two small white mouse Pokémon. They have a pattern on their fur resembling a blue shirt and pants, although very faint.

Shiny Tandemaus have yellow-gold shirt and pants.

Tandemaus are always seen in pairs and live as a couple. They frequently scavenge with their incisors to cut pieces of interesting nesting materials to create their own nest, with rooms intended for eating or sleeping. They always stay together no matter the circumstances and share their food exactly in half and eat together.

Tandemaus can "grow" a family, becoming a Maushold. It is not known where the smaller Tandemaus comes from, as they just "appeared" in front of the Tandemaus couple one day.

entities.name: Tadbulb
entities.short_description: The ninth generation (Generation IX) of the Pokémon franchise features 120 titular species of creatures introduced to the core video game series in the Nintendo Switch games Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. The first Pokémon…
entities.description:
The ninth generation (Generation IX) of the Pokémon franchise features 120 titular species of creatures introduced to the core video game series in the Nintendo Switch games Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. The first Pokémon of the generation were revealed on 27 February 2022 in a Pokémon Presents livestream presentation. Scarlet and Violet were released on 18 November 2022.

Pokémon are a species of fictional creatures created for the Pokémon media franchise. Developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo, the Japanese franchise began in 1996 with the video games Pokémon Red and Green for the Game Boy, which were later released in North America as Pokémon Red and Blue in 1998. In these games and their sequels, the player assumes the role of a Trainer whose goal is to capture and use the creatures' special abilities to combat other Pokémon. Some Pokémon can transform into stronger species through a process called evolution via various means, such as exposure to specific items. Each Pokémon have one or two elemental types, which define its advantages and disadvantages when battling other Pokémon. A major goal in each game is to complete the Pokédex, a comprehensive Pokémon encyclopedia, by capturing, evolving, and trading with other Trainers to obtain individuals from all Pokémon species.

Pokémon Scarlet and Violet take place in Paldea, which is heavily based on Spain, as well as other areas in the Iberian Peninsula, with the game's DLC expansions The Teal Mask and The Indigo Disk taking place in the Kitakami region and the Blueberry Academy, respectively. Kitakami is based on Japan, while the Blueberry Academy is a school environment set in the Unova region, the main location of the 2010 games Pokémon Black and White. Scarlet and Violet also feature a special mechanic known as "Terastallization" which allow the player's Pokémon to change their types in battle. The game Pokémon Legends: Z-A is set in the Kalos region, the main location of 2013 games Pokémon X and Y. It also saw the return of the "Mega Evolution" mechanic which was first introduced in those games; Mega Evolutions are powerful forms of Pokémon that can be used during Pokémon battles.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Nintendo / Creatures / Game Freak (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Rabsca
entities.short_description: Rabsca is a teal, pokemon that resembles a beetle. It floats in the air, carrying a purple, semi-translucent ball. It is upside down at all times a red face with white, furry protrusions from its face that resemble an…
entities.description:
Rabsca is a teal, pokemon that resembles a beetle. It floats in the air, carrying a purple, semi-translucent ball. It is upside down at all times a red face with white, furry protrusions from its face that resemble an extra set of legs. It's back possesses red patterns and sometimes it's eyes glow when it opens them.

Rabsca's hind legs carry a large, purple ball above its head. The ball is coated in purple goo save for a small opening on the front that is mostly transparent. Within the rough-shaped ball is a smaller ball with which an unborn creature can be seen. It is speculated that the pokemon carrying the ball is nothing more than a proxy for the pokemon within the ball. It is likely based on the Dung Beetle which rolls its namesake into a ball to use as either a food source or a mating chamber, which could be the reference the unborn creature within Rabsca's ball may hint to.

Rabsca evolves from Rellor after walking 1000 steps with it using the Let's Go! feature.

Rabsca appears to be based on a , specifically the sacred scarab. It's also likely based on , the scarab beetle-like Egyptian god of the sunrise, sometimes considered to be an aspect or avatar of the sun god .

entities.short_description: Shroodle is a small quadrupedal Pokémon with a dark grey body, a very small tail, a large black head with a tuft of white fur on top, small black semicircular ears, and a white underbelly with two-toed feet that have…
entities.description:
Shroodle is a small quadrupedal Pokémon with a dark grey body, a very small tail, a large black head with a tuft of white fur on top, small black semicircular ears, and a white underbelly with two-toed feet that have dark grey paw pads underneath. It has a long snout with two visible teeth and possesses large eyes that are gradient from green to yellow with small black pupils.

Shroodle marks its territory with poisonous liquid to keep out intruders. Although it is usually mellow, it will attack with its teeth if provoked.

Shroodle, being a -type Pokémon, has the ability to produce poisonous liquid from its teeth. This poison has the ability to cause paralysis.

Shroodle evolves into Grafaiai starting at level 28.

entities.description:
Rellor is a small, brown, beetle-like Pokémon that resembles a Dung Beetle. It is brown and always found rolling around a brown ball of mud. The main body is located behind the ball of mud and is generally shown upside down. On its back are white stripes that form intricate patterns.

Rellor almost always can be found upside down and rolling around a brown ball of mud.

Rellor creates its mud ball by mixing dirt and sand with psychic energy. It values its mud ball more than its own life and rolls it around as the energy needed for it to evolve matures. Its hind legs are strong enough to lift the mud ball over its body.

Rellor evolves into Rabsca after walking 1000 steps with it using the Let's Go! feature.

entities.name: Scovillain
entities.short_description: Scovillain is a medium-sized humanoid Pokémon that resembles a sort of chili pepper. It has two heads each with a different color and facial expression; the left head is green and has a smile while the right head is red…
entities.description:
Scovillain is a medium-sized humanoid Pokémon that resembles a sort of chili pepper. It has two heads each with a different color and facial expression; the left head is green and has a smile while the right head is red and has a scowl.

While most Scovillain have two different colored heads, there are rarer variants that have either two red or green heads, or a green right head and red left head.

Scovillain is able to process spicy chemicals within its two heads. However, there is a side effect from producing the chemicals. The red head releases the chemicals in the form of a fiery blast while the green head will cause Scovillain to go on a dangerous rampage.

Through processing spicy chemicals within both heads, Scovillain can spit highly flammable and hot flames from the red head and flaming seeds from the green head, respectively.

entities.description:
Toedscruel resembles its /-type counterpart, Tentacruel, except the top of its head and its nose are black with beige spots. its tentacles are also very light with yellow spots on the tips.

Toedscruel live in colonies deep in forests, and do not appreciate strangers. It moves by jumping around on its springy tentacles.

Toedscruel have strong tentacles to bind prey, and have the ability to siphon the energy of said prey.

Toedscruel evolves from Toedscool starting at level 30.

entities.description:
Toedscool resembles a Tentacool in most aspects, except its body is pink, the orbs on its head are yellow, and its tentacles are white and have "feet". The flaps above its lower body can fall off and have a chewy and delicious taste, making them used in recipes such as pickles.

Toedscool lives in humid forests and clings onto tree roots.

Toedscool is able to run at a speed of 30 miles per hour (50 kilometres and hour) using its spindly legs.

Toedscool evolves into Toedscruel starting at level 30.

entities.name: Wattrel
entities.short_description: Wattrel is a nest-building species; it makes its nest on top of cliffsides in coastal areas. Oddly enough, the nest that Wattrel builds is a sought-after delicacy as its crackling texture gives off a savory taste.
entities.description:
Wattrel is a nest-building species; it makes its nest on top of cliffsides in coastal areas. Oddly enough, the nest that Wattrel builds is a sought-after delicacy as its crackling texture gives off a savory taste.

Wattrel absorbs electricity from the wind that it catches via its wings. It uses this ability to electrocute underwater prey.

Wattrel evolves into Kilowattrel starting at level 27.

Wattrel's name may be based off of tne word "Watt", an electrical term, and possibly the bird species "".

entities.name: Tinkatink
entities.short_description: Tinkatink is a small humanoid that a steel star embedded in their chest. Being the youngest of its evolutionary line, they have an infant-like appearance to them, with their hammers looking much like a rattling toy.
entities.description:
Tinkatink is a small humanoid that a steel star embedded in their chest. Being the youngest of its evolutionary line, they have an infant-like appearance to them, with their hammers looking much like a rattling toy.

Being fragile as a species, Tinkatink swing their handmade hammers, which are pounded and made via iron scraps, to protect themselves. They always remake their hammers repeatedly until they're satisfied with the result. However, they also tend to lose their hammers to Pokémon that diet on metals, which often leaves them weak and defenseless.

Tinkatink are known for being able to sense and use metal to hone their hammers.

Tinkatink evolves into Tinkatuff starting at level 24 and then evolves into Tinkaton starting at level 38.

entities.name: Clodsire
entities.short_description: Clodsire is an amphibious Pokémon with a round body and is quadrupedal. It is a dark brown Pokémon with some lighter brown on the bottom half of it and forms a wave-like pattern in the center where the two colors meet.…
entities.description:
Clodsire is an amphibious Pokémon with a round body and is quadrupedal. It is a dark brown Pokémon with some lighter brown on the bottom half of it and forms a wave-like pattern in the center where the two colors meet. Clodsire has a large mouth paired with small black eyes and small nostrils. On its four stubby legs, it has 3 toes each, while a short fin travels from its lower back down to its wide, chubby tail. Along its back are six lavender colored spots which, if Clodsire is attacked, will cause large spines to stick out of them.

Clodsires live deep in swamps. To help Wooper, they will ferry them across the water on their backs.

Similarly to their regional cousin Quagsire, Clodsire can learn Water Absorb as an ability. Like their pre-evolved forms, Clodsire are adapted to living on land and are more durable then their cousins, but are more focused on defense and bulk. Clodsire use their spines as a self-defense mechanism, but it is considered dangerous and risky for it to do so.

Clodsire evolves from Paldean Wooper starting at level 20.

entities.name: Gholdengo
entities.short_description: Gholdengo is a primarily tube-shaped humanoid Pokémon made entirely of golden coins. It has skinny upper arms, and bulky lower arms with large hands comprised of three thick coin digits. It usually stands very upright…
entities.description:
Gholdengo is a primarily tube-shaped humanoid Pokémon made entirely of golden coins. It has skinny upper arms, and bulky lower arms with large hands comprised of three thick coin digits. It usually stands very upright with a pointing stance. It has four protrusions of cylindrical golden coin curls on its head that resemble tufts of hair. It has a mainly cylindrical body that grows plumper at the waist, and thick cylindrical legs. It wears a loose-fitting black belt around its waist with a silver belt buckle with the number 1000 imprinted on it. Gholdengo's belt is also holding the treasure chest it had when it was a Gimmighoul. Gholdengo also has bright-yellow oval-shaped eyes, and a crooked smile with a rounded protrusion resembling a tooth.

Gholdengo has a particularly friendly disposition, and can easily befriend anyone, both humans and Pokémon. It is calm, and has a carefree and confident personality. When excited, it will jump up into the air with an expression of glee (and when surfing on water, its legs will still be attached to its hovering board). When drowsy, it will sit, then lie down on its side and sleep in a luxurious manner, with its head propped up slightly by its hand, and on of its thick, plump legs curled in slightly as it positions its other hand on its hip.

As seen in Scarlet and Violet, a Gholdengo will interact particularly cheerfully with its trainer (e.g. when sent out in Let's Go! mode, and during picnics), often approaching more often than most Pokémon, uttering its cry, and laughing joyfully with an unchanging grin. It will also sleep near the trainer with a permanent and unchanging smile etched on its face. It will often engage other Pokémon during picnics and act cheerily toward them as well.

Gholdengo is nearly almost seen smiling and joyful, aside from one official artwork in the Paldean Fates card series, in which it appears to be howling in a ghostly manner and frowning as it blasts out a barrage of coins. But, as seen in the games, this Pokémon grins cheerfully even when facing and attacking its opponents.

Nymble evolves into Lokix starting at level 24.

Nymble appears to be based on a . The fact that it cannot fly, unlike most grasshoppers, may suggest it is based on a meadow grasshopper, or a grasshopper in its nymph stage, which is alluded to in its English name. It may also be based on due to its coloration and rounded features. The way its third set of legs fold up resembles .

Nymble may be based off the words "nymph" and "nimble", which means quick and fast.

entities.name: Bombirdier
entities.short_description: Bombirdier is a bird Pokémon which looks similar to a stork. It has fanned-out feathers on the back of its head, a long and narrow pink beak with a bump on its end, and dark slanted eyes. It has a long neck and a slim…
entities.description:
Bombirdier is a bird Pokémon which looks similar to a stork. It has fanned-out feathers on the back of its head, a long and narrow pink beak with a bump on its end, and dark slanted eyes. It has a long neck and a slim build, with long legs and talons of the same color as the beak. It has three toes per foot which face forward, and one on the back of each foot. The claws are black, alongside the feathers on the lower half of the body, the tips of it's wings, and the inside of the square-ended tail, whereas the rest of the feathers are white.

A very long, white apron made of its own feathers drapes over the front of its body and down past its legs.

The Open Sky Titan, one of the Paldea region's Titan Pokémon, is a giant Bombirdier.

Bombirdier stores food in the apron it forms from its shed feathers to bring back to its nest. When not foraging for food, they are very fond of placing various items in them, then flying somewhere and dropping them from above. They particularly enjoy dropping items that make loud noises for fun.

entities.name: Finizen
entities.short_description: Finizen is a small cetacean Pokémon that resembles a dolphin. Its body is primarily aquamarine with a white underbelly. Finizen has a pair to pink eyes and a cream-colored dorsal fin.
entities.description:
Finizen is a small cetacean Pokémon that resembles a dolphin. Its body is primarily aquamarine with a white underbelly. Finizen has a pair to pink eyes and a cream-colored dorsal fin.

Finizen is a very playful Pokémon and will usually interact with its own species. In Paldea, Finizen often view Barraskewda as a potential rival as both species are competing for food. Dragalge is Finizen's natural predator.

Finizen emits ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other Pokémon. The water ring attached to Finizen's tail is made from a mixture of sticky fluids (which Finizen secretes from its blowhole) and seawater.

Finizen evolves into Palafin starting at level 38 when in a Union Circle with another player.

entities.short_description: Tinkatuff appears to be an adolescent-looking humanoid, with the steel star that they once had as a Tinkatink removed. They are slightly taller and their hammers now look like an actual weapon.
entities.description:
Tinkatuff appears to be an adolescent-looking humanoid, with the steel star that they once had as a Tinkatink removed. They are slightly taller and their hammers now look like an actual weapon.

Tinkatuff are Pokémon that live in groups, making homes in piles of scrapped metal. They usually smash each other's hammers to test their own strengths. Feisty and cruel, they are infamous for outgunning packs of Pawniard and Bisharp to finish them off and then rip their armors from their bodies to create their own large and sturdy hammers.

Like its pre-evolution and evolution, Tinkatuff are known for being able to sense and use metal to hone their hammers. They are also strong enough to take on packs of Pawniard and Bisharp.

Tinkatuff evolves from Tinkatink starting at level 24 and evolves into Tinkaton starting at level 38.

entities.name: Wugtrio
entities.short_description: Wugtrio a red pokemon that looks to be three worms that live in a single rock. They possess a large nose and large eyes with blue pupils and no sclera. They appear to appear to be similar to Dugtrio, but are…
entities.description:
Wugtrio a red pokemon that looks to be three worms that live in a single rock. They possess a large nose and large eyes with blue pupils and no sclera. They appear to appear to be similar to Dugtrio, but are distinguished as completely different pokemon.

Wugtrio are agressive creatures that hunt by wrapping their heads around creatures and dragging them into the deep.

Wugtrio is the only known Pokémon capable of learning the move Triple Dive.

Wugtrio evolves from Wiglett starting at level 26.

entities.name: Palafin
entities.short_description: In its Zero form resembles Finizen but with a heart on its underbelly.
entities.description:
In its Zero form resembles Finizen but with a heart on its underbelly.

In its Hero form, it stands up with the heart on its chest looking larger, and also gains hands. The heart now looks more like a shield.

When hearing an allies calling for help, Palafin will transform from its "Zero" form into its "Hero" form to help those in need such as drowning people and Pokémon. However, they refuse to show the moment of their transformation to others.

Palafin comes with the ability Zero to Hero, which causes it to change into its "Hero" form when swapped out but redeployed during battle. In its Hero form, it is extraordinary strong due to awakening its ancient genes, and it can lift a cruise ship with ease with just one fin and travel at rapid speeds of 50 knots.

entities.name: Revavroom
entities.short_description: Revavroom is a vehicular Pokémon with a primarily black body. It has four black wheels and a silver engine attached to its body. Eight exhaust pipes stick out of the engine, with each pipe covered in a purple liquid,…
entities.description:
Revavroom is a vehicular Pokémon with a primarily black body. It has four black wheels and a silver engine attached to its body. Eight exhaust pipes stick out of the engine, with each pipe covered in a purple liquid, which it could be poison. the six exhaust pipes are smaller and stick out of the longer exhaust pipes. Revavroom also has a single yellow eye in front of the engine. On top of Revavroom's engine is a large cylindrical mouth armed with a pair of sharp teeth.

Revavroom uses its loud engine to scare off enemies. It absorbs minerals and poisonous gases inside its engine in order to produce energy before detonating the energy from its eight cylinders.

Revavroom possesses a long tongue that it uses to spray toxic fluids. It can also function as a power source by plugging into machines, which Ortega used by creating unique Starmobile forms for it. Additionally, Revavroom's Starmobile forms are also capable of using the moves Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Magical Torque, Noxious Torque, and Wicked Torque.

Revavroom evolves from Varoom starting at level 40.

entities.short_description: Glimmet is very small and thin Pokémon. It has a flower-shaped head with yellow eyes and petals made of crystallized poison along with a long and unprotected stem.
entities.description:
Glimmet is very small and thin Pokémon. It has a flower-shaped head with yellow eyes and petals made of crystallized poison along with a long and unprotected stem.

Glimmet reside in caves to absorb nutrients from cave walls. When attacked, they release their powder-like pollen in the form of spikes to protect itself.

Glimmet, along with its evolution Glimmora, have the unique ability Toxic Debris, where they apply a layer of Toxic Spikes on the field if directly attacked. They can also poison -types with Corrosion.

Glimmet evolves into Glimmora starting at level 35.

entities.name: Orthworm
entities.short_description: Orthworm is a long worm-like pokemon that appears very robotic. It resembles an earth worm, but with a body made of metal instead of flesh. Unlike the Earth Worms that this pokemon is based after, it possesses a set of…
entities.description:
Orthworm is a long worm-like pokemon that appears very robotic. It resembles an earth worm, but with a body made of metal instead of flesh. Unlike the Earth Worms that this pokemon is based after, it possesses a set of blue, digital eyes and tendrils down the side of its body which can extend and be used as a weapon.

When threatened, Orthworm uses its tendrils to punch its opponents. Orthworm lives in dry deserts, and eats iron from the soil to maintain its body. It is sometimes seen buried in the ground, with only its head visible.

Orthworm is the only known Pokémon that can have Earth Eater as an Ability.

Orthworm's design is a combination of a worm and a subway train. Its tendrils may be derived from the pronounced parapodia of polychaetes, relatives of earthworms.

entities.description:
Glimmora resembles a floating chunk of crystal with a primarily blue body like its pre-evolution. However, the petals have grown much larger and now enclose its thin stem.

When it senses danger, Glimmora opens up its petals and shoot out energy beams from its body. Its petals are extremely poisonous and have a slight resemblance to Tera crystals.

Glimmora, along with its pre-evolution, have the unique ability Toxic Debris, where they apply a layer of Toxic Spikes on the field if directly attacked. They can also poison -types with Corrosion.

Glimmora evolves from Glimmet starting at level 35. Glimmora can Mega Evolve into Mega Glimmora using its Glimmoranite.

entities.name: Annihilape
entities.short_description: Being completely different from its pre-evolution, its fur turns ash gray and sticks up while the tips of them turn white. with bits of white hairs floating around it. Its eyes turn red, has dark gray legs and arms and…
entities.description:
Being completely different from its pre-evolution, its fur turns ash gray and sticks up while the tips of them turn white. with bits of white hairs floating around it. Its eyes turn red, has dark gray legs and arms and has two broken shackles on each of its legs, but has one cracked shackle on its left arm, however its right arm does not have a shackle.

Annihilape is the result of a Primeape's anger having reached a critical point, which is achieved by using Rage Fist multiple times to the point of bursting its head's blood vessels. They are unfettered by the limits of their physical bodies and unleashes their wrathful punches to completely annihilate their opponents. Despite their anger they are incredibly calm in a sense, due to accepting anger as a part of their lives.

Annihilape can completely destroy their foes simply through their rage-imbued fists that are bolstered from their accrued rage deep inside their hearts, pulverizing their foes with mortal wounds that can effectively kill them.

Annihilape evolves from Primeape if leveled up after using Rage Fist 20 times and is the final evolution of Mankey.

entities.name: Cetoddle
entities.short_description: Cetoddle is a large, round mammalian pokemon with a single tooth or tusk on the lower half of its mouth, and a horn sticking out of its forehead. It has large, round eyes, a stubby pair of legs, arms shaped like fins,…
entities.description:
Cetoddle is a large, round mammalian pokemon with a single tooth or tusk on the lower half of its mouth, and a horn sticking out of its forehead. It has large, round eyes, a stubby pair of legs, arms shaped like fins, and a tail fin, all attached to the round body that seems mostly to be its head. It also has pink spots on its body.

Cetoddle is believed to be a close relative of Wailmer. This is disputed however as Wailmer used to be a land dwelling species before becoming a sea-fairing one, which is the direct opposite of Cetoddle which came from the sea and began living on the land. After becoming a land dwelling species, Cetoddle began living in cold regions where it enjoys eating snow for the minerals inside. They live in packs, generally about five per pack.

Cetoddle evolves into Cetitan if it touches an Ice Stone.

Cetoddle appears to be inspired by different cetaceans, most notably s based on their highly arched mouth, round body without dorsal fin, belly without ventral grooves, and horns near their jaw (which may be based on the callosities found on the head and mouth of right whales). Right whales were heavily hunted for thick blubber and oils and were named because they were "right whales to hunt" due to their inquisitiveness and calm natures. These correspond with that of Cetoddle and Cetitan to be friendly by nature and possess thick fats and drop Cetoddle Grease on occasions, and were heavily hunted in , the inspiration source of Paldea, and were called "Balea Vasca" ("whales of Basque"), and is now virtually extinct in European and African waters. North Atlantic right whale's scientific name (Eubalaena glacialis) means "true whales of ice", somewhat corresponding to the type of Cetitan.

entities.name: Brute Bonnet
entities.short_description: Brute Bonnet is an anthropomorphic and slightly saurian, plump-bodied mushroom-like Pokémon that appears to be an ancient relative of Amoonguss. Like Amoonguss, it is primarily cream-colored. Its cap has six sharp…
entities.description:
Brute Bonnet is an anthropomorphic and slightly saurian, plump-bodied mushroom-like Pokémon that appears to be an ancient relative of Amoonguss. Like Amoonguss, it is primarily cream-colored. Its cap has six sharp spikes poking upward, and resembles the design and color of a Poké Ball; it has two thin arms with the same pattern as its head that serve as large shield-like "hands" that it always upholds. Hanging down from its mushroom cap is a drape of translucent bright-green moss that partially covers its eyes. Like many Paradox Pokémon, it has yellow eyes with slit black pupils and magenta eyelids. Its underside is brown; it has a plump belly, four stumpy legs, and a long tail resembling that of a dinosaur. Its rounded dark-pink mouth has sharp fangs.

Despite its large size and menacing looks, Brute Bonnet is described as not being very smart. However, it is a very powerful and savage fighter, even though it possesses a low intellect. It opens and bears its sharp fangs threateningly when facing an opponent, and holds up its arms with large, round hands like shields. Due to the name that it was given, it had a brutish nature.

Brute Bonnet can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy.

Sc; It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon. V; It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

entities.name: Flamigo
entities.short_description: Flamigo is a tall bird-like Pokemon heavily resembling a flamingo. The majority of its body rounded is colored pink, and its neck is tied into a knot at the base. As for Flamigo's legs, they are long and white with…
entities.description:
Flamigo is a tall bird-like Pokemon heavily resembling a flamingo. The majority of its body rounded is colored pink, and its neck is tied into a knot at the base. As for Flamigo's legs, they are long and white with webbed feet. It also has a white face and black at the tip of the beak. Flamigo's eyes are yellow and the pupils are black.

Shiny Flamigo have a lighter hue of pink to them.

Flocks of Flamigo are known to attack together in perfect harmony, via a behavior known as "synchronizing".

Flamigo is the only known Pokémon that can have Costar as an Ability.

entities.name: Houndstone
entities.short_description: Houndstone is a large canine that appears to be a skull and bones covered in long, ghostly white hair. Its tail is two jagged bones connected together, and its four feet are composed of three toe bones per foot…
entities.description:
Houndstone is a large canine that appears to be a skull and bones covered in long, ghostly white hair. Its tail is two jagged bones connected together, and its four feet are composed of three toe bones per foot connected to a heel bone and a leg bone that extends up past the hairline. It has a large hump on its back, but as Houndstone doesn't appear to have any fat or muscle, it's unknown what this hump is composed of. Its eyes are not seen as they are also covered in hair, but its large snout can be seen, possessing a massive underbite. The most prominent feature, though, is the massive tombstone sticking out of its head after which this Pokémon derives its name.

Shiny Houndstone have dark brown humps and their white hair changed to a light brown color.

Houndstone are immensely loyal Pokémon towards their Trainers and the loyalest amid all known dog Pokémon, despite their eerie skeleton-like countenance. They are nocturnal and normally spend their time slumbering in graveyards. They are friendly, but dislike those who touch the protuberances atop their heads.

It is rumored that a Houndstone is reborn from a lovingly mourned Pokémon.

entities.name: Dudunsparce
entities.short_description: Dudunsparce is a Pokémon that is near identical to its pre-evolution, Dunsparce. However, its body is now longer with a segment added to it. Each segment has a pair of wings. The very end of the tail has gained a cap.…
entities.description:
Dudunsparce is a Pokémon that is near identical to its pre-evolution, Dunsparce. However, its body is now longer with a segment added to it. Each segment has a pair of wings. The very end of the tail has gained a cap. It also now has three spikes coming from its chin and its eyes now appear to have eyelids.

Most Dudunsparce gain one segment, giving them two pairs of wings, but a few individuals gain two segments, giving them three pairs of wings.

Dudunsparce are gentle in nature, and will carry Pokémon who wander into its den and guide them out.

Dudunsparce is able to use its hard tail to bore holes into bedrock deep underground, creating nests that can reach up to six miles. It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in air with its long narrow lungs and then releasing the air in an intense blast.

entities.name: Flutter Mane
entities.short_description: Flutter Mane is a dark teal Pokémon that highly resembles Misdreavus, as it is its ancient relative. It has a significantly larger head than its present-day counterpart, and possesses longer tentacles sprouting from its…
entities.description:
Flutter Mane is a dark teal Pokémon that highly resembles Misdreavus, as it is its ancient relative. It has a significantly larger head than its present-day counterpart, and possesses longer tentacles sprouting from its forehead, with purplish-pink featherlike streaks at the ends; one frill has a lighter-teal colour than the rest. It has a red pearl necklace-like feature below its head, and three red spikes lining the top of its head. It bears a permanent mischievous-looking grin with a single sharp tooth showing. Its large half-circular eyes have red sclerae, yellow irises with slit cat- or snake-like pupils, bordered with thin black eyelids. The bottom of its body possesses multiple spike-like frills that form a dress-like shape, with a single frill in particular being red in color.

Flutter Mane is said to have a highly fierce and aggressive, mischievous nature. However, it is also observed to be rather curious as well. It was believed to be a giant Misdreavus at first. It is believed that Flutter Mane is the ghost of a deceased pterosaur.

Flutter Mane can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it's holding a Booster Energy.

Flutter Mane does not evolve, due to Mismagius not having a Paradox Pokémon form.

entities.name: Great Tusk
entities.short_description: Great Tusk is a large primarily gray pachyderm Pokémon that appears to be an ancient variant or ancestor of Donphan. Its prominent feature, which it is named after, are its massive, and particularly large and long…
entities.description:
Great Tusk is a large primarily gray pachyderm Pokémon that appears to be an ancient variant or ancestor of Donphan. Its prominent feature, which it is named after, are its massive, and particularly large and long tusks, that are a light-tan color; the tusks stem from is upper jaw and curl inward toward up to its forehead. It has a long dark-grey heavily segmented trunk that curls over its head and its back, and down its tail. Its trunk, back, and dinosaur-like tail are covered with many magenta scale-like spikes. From its hefty trunk and back, upon its head stem two long thin ears with magenta flesh inside. It has short legs with three white claws; fluffy magenta tufts of fur curl around them. The skin covering it body is light grey, with three magenta scales on each side. It has a large mouth with jagged teeth, and small yellow eyes with slit pupils, and magenta eyelids.

Great Tusk, as documented in the Scarlet Book, is a ferocious Pokémon that attacks its opponents with its large and powerful tusks. It is dangerously aggressive toward creatures that approach it, as it is primal in nature.

Though as seen in Pokémon Scarlet, even in Titan Form, this Pokémon can be tamed like any other once calmed and captured, and becomes loyal and friendly to a skilled trainer.

Great Tusk can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it's holding a Booster Energy.

entities.name: Iron Treads
entities.short_description: Iron Treads is a large Future Paradox Pokémon resembling a highly mechanical/robotic Donphan. It has a vaguely pachyderm-like appearance. It is a particularly round Pokémon, its main body being comprised of segmented…
entities.description:
Iron Treads is a large Future Paradox Pokémon resembling a highly mechanical/robotic Donphan. It has a vaguely pachyderm-like appearance. It is a particularly round Pokémon, its main body being comprised of segmented gun-metal-grey plates. Its face resembles a crescent-shaped display-screen with narrowed red pixilated eyes, and below it has a frowning robotic mouth that can open and close. It lacks an actual trunk, and does not have a nose. Though initially appearing fierce and angry, its expression varies depending on its mood; it can simulate blinking and different expressions by changing the display pattern. Two darker-silver tusk-like metal spines protrude from either side of its face, and it has ear-like flaps of the same dark metal exending from each side of its body. It has short mechanical legs that it can fold-in and protract at will. It has long, black and glowing red segmented rotating treads extending over its entire body, appearing vaguely as a trunk and tail. Its long front part and tail-end can connect at the center of its belly, forming treads and a powerful robotic wheel in which it can use to travel at very high speeds as it folds in all of its limbs to become more aerodynamic. When tired, its red glow and monitor turns off and it enters a type of sleep-mode.

Iron Treads is an aggressive Paradox Pokémon that attacks by curling into a ball and rolling at high-speed, leaving behind a trail of scorched earth.

With its Quark Drive ability, like all Future Paradox Pokémon, Iron Treads can increase its Speed and highest stat when Electric Terrain is active, or if holding a Booster Energy. Iron Treads makes use of its robotic pseudo-trunk as fast-moving treads to move at high-speeds.

Iron Treads is the Future equivalent of Great Tusk.

entities.name: Scream Tail
entities.short_description: Scream Tail is a round and pink Pokémon that resembles a Jigglypuff with subtle differences and a larger size, appearing as its Past Paradox counterpart. Its large circular eyes are bright-yellow, with small darker-pink…
entities.description:
Scream Tail is a round and pink Pokémon that resembles a Jigglypuff with subtle differences and a larger size, appearing as its Past Paradox counterpart. Its large circular eyes are bright-yellow, with small darker-pink round specks beneath each one, as well as slightly darker pink slightly curled markings that resemble lashes above its eyes. Its mouth, which it can open up widely to emit loud screams, has two sharp, protruding fangs. Short tufts of fur fringe out beside its traingle-shaped ears. It possesses a distinctly long, thick tuft of fur protruding from its forehead that curls back behind it; this tuft tapers off to a darker-pink colour. It has two clawed feet with three digits, and two stubby arms. It has a short dinosaur-like/draconic pointed tail.

Shiny Scream Tail has a more violet coloration compared to its non-shiny counterpart. Its eyes are scarlet-red rather than yellow.

Scream Tail is said to be a prehistoric Jigglypuff from approximately one billion years ago. It is said to be ferociously aggressive in the wild; it has the potential to attack anyone who comes near out of aggression. It is named after a creature with distinct tail and loud screaming voice.

Scream Tail can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy. It is able to levitate and hover, as well as emit sonic-blast screams to fight off its opponents.

entities.name: Sandy Shocks
entities.short_description: Sandy Shocks is an ancient Paradox Pokémon that resembles the artificial Pokémon Magneton with contrasting prehistoric looks. It is a silvery-blue metallic creature made up of three magnetized electric orbs, with screws…
entities.description:
Sandy Shocks is an ancient Paradox Pokémon that resembles the artificial Pokémon Magneton with contrasting prehistoric looks. It is a silvery-blue metallic creature made up of three magnetized electric orbs, with screws attached to each. Electromagnetism appears to hold this Pokémon together. Each orb seems to function as a head, with a round yellow eye and black pupils on each; the main top orb (that resembles a single Magnemite) has purplish markings above the eye, and four black dots below it, vaguely resembling a face. Sandy Shocks possesses four magnet-like formations (with red and blue, positive and negative, markings at the ends) that act as limbs (arms and legs) attached to its body. Two short magnets are attached to the top head (acting as arms), and two long, flexible manget-limbs attached to each of its bottom heads, which it uses as legs to crawl and walk. The tips of each magnet on this Pokémon are coated in tufts of iron filings. The top of its main "head" is tipped with a large bolt frilled with iron particles. Sandy Shocks has a long tail made of attached bolts, and tipped with an iron filling tuft.

It is said to resemble a Magneton that has lived for 10,000 years. There have been many sightings of Sandy Shocks, where no one apparently has been able to capture it. Sandy Shocks is known to be very aggressive, attacking anyone who has seen it. It takes its name from a matching description in Scarlet Book.

Sandy Shocks can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy. It uses its long flexible magnet-like legs to crawl and propel itself swiftly across the ground. Its magnet-limbs appear to naturally attract iron fillings.

Sandy Shocks is inspired by Magneton, resembling a prehistoric form of it. Its inspiration might be based on natural electromagnetism within the earth and certain natural metal elements that are magnetic (as Magneton, its present-day counterpart, is an artificial robotic Pokémon).

entities.name: Slither Wing
entities.short_description: Slither Wing is a large moth-like Pokémon with some dinosaur-like traits. Its dark-bluish face is insectoid, with a short pointed proboscis, and spiky orange horn-like structures on the side of its face in place of…
entities.description:
Slither Wing is a large moth-like Pokémon with some dinosaur-like traits. Its dark-bluish face is insectoid, with a short pointed proboscis, and spiky orange horn-like structures on the side of its face in place of antennae, with the same shape pattern and colour lining its eyes. It has large oval-shaped yellow eyes that appear compound, split into four by a cross-like shape. It possesses six large rudimentary yet strongly-muscled wings on its back; each of its wings are orange, tapering to yellow, with yellow diamond-shaped markings speckling them from top to bottom. Its thorax and abdomen are mostly covered in a mass of thick, fluffy white fur. Its chest is covered in fur, while its plump dark-blue belly is bare and segmented. It has four stubby legs covered in white fur, with dark-blue feet. Its two front-feet are pointed, while its back legs are heavier than its front legs, and possess more muscle-mass. Its distinctly boot-shaped back-feet that are larger than its pointed-shaped front-feet. Its powerful back legs and large hind-feet enable it to lift itself and stand upright. It has a thick, teal-colored, segmented dinosaur-like tail with a row of greenish-yellow spines lining it, and a dark-blue dot on the underside of each segment.

Slither Wing is an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine. It is said to share many traits with Volcarona, and its name came from a similarly described creature in the Scarlet Book. There have been rare sightings of Slither Wing. It is believed Slither Wing may have been revived from a fossil from a prehistoric era, despite no fossil evidence.

Slither Wing can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy. Despite crawling on its belly most of the time, it is very physically powerful and musculed (being a -type), and can stand up on its strong back legs and heavy feet. Although its massive wings are rudimentary, it can expand and flap them to deter or threaten its enemies.

Slither Wing is most based on a moth and with some saurian traits. Similar to Volcarona, it also has some physical traits of an Atlas moth. Slither Wing might also share some similarities with Mothra Leo, a kaiju that resembles a semi matured moth larva, as well as being the offspring of Mothra (another kaiju that is possibly an inspiration for Volcarona). Its overall physical appearance (mainly its tail and posture) might draw some inspirations from dinosaurs.

entities.short_description: Veluza is a slender fish-like Pokémon. It has a gray-silver like body with purple fins. The eyes are purple and its mouth is open, revealing the sharp teeth within.
entities.description:
Veluza is a slender fish-like Pokémon. It has a gray-silver like body with purple fins. The eyes are purple and its mouth is open, revealing the sharp teeth within.

Shiny Veluza have all the purple replaced with green.

Veluza is known to periodically discard unnecessary flesh in order to boost its agility and powers. The discarded flesh is said to have a mild but delicious flavor.

Veluza is known to have excellent regeneration capabilities and psychic powers.

entities.name: Arctibax
entities.short_description: Arctibax is a short reptilian Pokemon with a primarily blue body, ice covering its snout and eyebrows, a light blue belly and claws, yellow eyes with black pupils, light orange quills covering its forearms near the…
entities.description:
Arctibax is a short reptilian Pokemon with a primarily blue body, ice covering its snout and eyebrows, a light blue belly and claws, yellow eyes with black pupils, light orange quills covering its forearms near the hands, and a navy blue dorsal fin with a three-point icicle resembling a snowflake protruding on the back. It now walks with its head leaning forward and the tail sticking out for balance similar to a Spinosaurus.

Arctibax evolves from Frigibax starting at level 35 and evolves into Baxcalibur starting at level 54.

Baxcalibur is based on certain dinosaurs including Concavenator, Ouranosaurus, Spinosaurus, Dimetrodon, and Arizonasaurus.

Baxcalibur is a portmanteau of arctic, back, and axe.

entities.name: Baxcalibur
entities.short_description: Baxcalibur is a large draconic/saurian Pokémon that resembles a bipedal dinosaur. It has a primarily dark grey body and light grey hexagon-shaped patches that cover its underbelly and knee pads. Its face is covered with…
entities.description:
Baxcalibur is a large draconic/saurian Pokémon that resembles a bipedal dinosaur. It has a primarily dark grey body and light grey hexagon-shaped patches that cover its underbelly and knee pads. Its face is covered with a white ice mask while its three front sharp claws are covered with red quills. On its back lies a large dorsal plate with a black diamond inside of it with ice lining the outside.

Best seen when using its signature move, Glaive Rush, Baxcalibur uses its icy breath to propel forward while upside down, and its head and limbs as support. It then finishes off its opponent with a single strike from its large blade-shaped dorsal fin.

Baxcalibur's icy breath is capable of freezing anything solid, even lava.

Baxcalibur evolves from Arctibax starting at level 54 and is the final evolution of Frigibax. Baxcalibur can Mega Evolve into Mega Baxcalibur using its Baxcalibrite.

entities.name: Frigibax
entities.short_description: Frigibax is a small reptilian Pokemon with a round gray body, a white snout, a light blue belly, a navy blue dorsal fin sitting on a light blue spot on its back, big yellow eyes with black pupils, two yellow droopy…
entities.description:
Frigibax is a small reptilian Pokemon with a round gray body, a white snout, a light blue belly, a navy blue dorsal fin sitting on a light blue spot on its back, big yellow eyes with black pupils, two yellow droopy tendrils on the arms, a short tail, and a small piece of ice located on the left side of its lower jaw, resembling a cold sore.

Frigibax dwell in frigid and craggy areas. They often have fights with Bergmite.

Frigibax can use its dorsal fin to regulate its surrounding temperature by converting heat into ice energy. If an environment is cold, it means a Frigibax nearby has been storing a lot of energy to cool its nest.

Frigibax evolves into Arctibax starting at level 35 and then evolves into Baxcalibur starting at level 54.

entities.name: Iron Bundle
entities.short_description: Iron Bundle is a Future Paradox mechanical penguin-like Pokémon resembling Delibird. Its upper body is comprised of white metal, while its lower body is mostly red. It has two white "tufts" that resemble feathers upon…
entities.description:
Iron Bundle is a Future Paradox mechanical penguin-like Pokémon resembling Delibird. Its upper body is comprised of white metal, while its lower body is mostly red. It has two white "tufts" that resemble feathers upon its forehead, a small yellow mechanical beak, and its eyes are blue with black, digital sclera. It is small and plump, with a rounded belly; a luminous blue dot-like patch in the center appears as its "navel". It has two stubby, robotic oval-shaped arms (with black metallic undersides), and carries around a large orb-shaped tank made of a blue, crystalline, cryogenic substance, which it also attaches to its back as a type of sack. It has a large black tube with glowing blue segments running up its back, which attaches to its tank. Its feet are long, yellow, and vaguely talon-like, ending in two up-turned toes.

Though fierce as any Paradox Pokémon, Iron Bundle acts jolly around its trainer once captured. Like all Future Paradox Pokémon, it enters a "sleep mode" in which its glowing blue patches and pixilated eyes go dark.

Ancient writings allegedly describe the design and usage of machines resembling Iron Bundle, leading to speculation that it may have been built by a long-lost civilization.

With its Quark Drive ability, like all Future Paradox Pokémon, Iron Bundle can increase its Speed and highest stat when Electric Terrain is active, or if holding a Booster Energy. According to the paranormal magazine "Occulture", the spherical device Iron Bundle carries can fire ice blasts, which it uses as a form of propulsion when attached to its back.

entities.name: Iron Moth
entities.short_description: Iron Moth is a robotic or cybernetic insectoid moth Paradox Pokémon. It is very similar if not outright identical to Volcarona in appearance, though appearing as a robotic/cybernetic version of it. It has a mostly black…
entities.description:
Iron Moth is a robotic or cybernetic insectoid moth Paradox Pokémon. It is very similar if not outright identical to Volcarona in appearance, though appearing as a robotic/cybernetic version of it. It has a mostly black body with a white thorax mimicking fur. It has four small inward-pointing limbs on its thorax, though they now appear to lack a function and do not seem to move very much. Its metallic black thorax creases into a mostly black plump abdomen bordered by light teal, though it is thinner and more aerodynamic-shaped than its present day counterpart. There are two oval-shaped black limb-like appendages, one on each side of its abdomen. It possesses six glowing, fiery orange, diamond-shaped wings tipped at the center with red metal, and black triangular markings within. Its robotic wings float independent of it's body. It's eyes have a cross pattern going through them to split them into four compound eyes that are a dark shade of orange, and two crimson antennae bordering its head and pointing up like horns.

According to the paranormal magazine "Occulture", it sporadically descends from the skies to attack random people for no clear reason. The magazine claims that Iron Moth may have been sent by aliens to spy on humanity. Though it is dangerous as a mysterious robotic Pokémon from an unknown future, when tamed by a skilled trainer, it is able to bond and express some level of emotion (as seen in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet).

Iron Moth, unlike its present-day counterpart Volcarona, levitates skillfully without the use of its blazing, glowing metallic wings, which move rigidly. It can emit and control flames and venom.

Iron Moth is the Future equivalent of Slither Wing.

entities.name: Iron Jugulis
entities.short_description: Iron Jugulis is a large cybernetic draconic Pokémon that resembles Hydreigon. It has a round plump body, and possesses three heads, with two of the heads acting as its hands, hovering separate from its body. It has…
entities.description:
Iron Jugulis is a large cybernetic draconic Pokémon that resembles Hydreigon. It has a round plump body, and possesses three heads, with two of the heads acting as its hands, hovering separate from its body. It has short stub-like mechanical back legs, and a short, thin tail. It has various luminous, vaguely crystalline-looking magenta frills covering its three heads, and magenta stripes containing the same glowing plasma-like energy on its belly and tail. It has six thin black mechanical wings that it flaps, but seems to levitate with its cybernetic energy for the most part. Its heads, legs, part of its tail, and sides, are blue, with most of its body being metallic-black in color.

According to the paranormal magazine "Occulture", it was reported to have razed a building with a high-energy blast before flying off as if finding a new objective. As it combines Hydreigon's ferocity with the ruthlessness of a machine, it is believed to be some sort of cybernetic Hydreigon. Though ferocious in nature, once captured and tamed (as seen in its behavior in Scarlet and Violet), it becomes very loyal, and expresses natural-looking emotions (with all three of its heads) such as happiness, when interacted with. Unlike its present-day counterpart Hydreigon, it often displays happiness (expressed in all of its heads), rather than an expression of ferocity, toward its trainer. This behavior is unnatural for a purely mechanical creature; it acts as a cybernetic organism (similar to Miraidon).

Being a futuristic, cybernetic Hydreigon, Iron Jugulis possesses similar abilities to its present-day counterpart. Its thin metallic wings allow it to levitate. It has the abilities to use powerful, destructive plasmic energy, though it is intelligent and considers new objectives as it develops.
